verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party claim that Fedora Workstation runs well on, or extends the life of, older hardware. The 'performance mode' power toggle and default zram/oomd are generic features, not older-hardware support. The only hands-on report about older hardware describes Wayland trouble, including a screen that does not come back after sleep, and another user reports multi-minute freezes when RAM fills. These are user reports rather than contradictions of a vendor claim, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.
